about.title: About me
about.bio1: I am a Full-Stack Developer and Automation Specialist focused on building scalable web applications and software tools that drive tangible business results. My expertise spans backend architecture, databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB), and REST/GraphQL APIs (Python, Django, Flask) to modern, fast, and interactive frontend interfaces (React, JavaScript, HTMX).
about.bio2: My approach combines high-standard software engineering, user-centered design, and process automation (Web Scraping, bots, and AI integrations). With over 200 commercial projects delivered to production, I help businesses optimize their operations, accelerate turnaround, and scale with confidence.
